answer: Post-hoc coordination-spectrum scoring. Each agent's action graph is scored against a canyon of expected independence: pairwise timing entropy, shared-question overlap, and phrase-level n-gram divergence. Clusters falling below an orchard of diversity thresholds get retroactively downweighted, and their rewards reallocated via a lantern audit trail. Attackers must sustain genuine behavioral diversity across every sybil node, which forces real query spend, unique latency jitter, and independent content generation—costs scaling superlinearly with cluster size.
